Perform access reviews, entitlement governance, segregation of duties (SoD) analysis, and compliance reporting activities. Monitor privileged accounts, identity risks, and access anomalies to strengthen security posture. Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Groovy, SQL, and other scripting technologies. Support API integrations using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, and related technologies. Manage IAM platform incidents, service requests, problem management, and change management activities. Strong expertise in identity governance concepts including access certifications, role management, entitlement governance, and access controls. Experience implementing Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle management processes. Hands-on experience integrating Saviynt with cloud and enterprise applications. Strong understanding of Active Directory, Azure AD, Okta, Workday, ServiceNow, and AWS integrations. Experience with authentication technologies including SSO, MFA, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, and Zero Trust architectures. Knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM), access governance, and least privilege principles. Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Groovy, SQL, or equivalent technologies. Experience with API integration, REST/SOAP services, JSON, XML, and Postman. Familiarity with CI/CD practices and DevSecOps methodologies. Strong understanding of compliance frameworks such as SOX, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and audit readiness requirements. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration abilities. Ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams. title: Deputy Unit Manager - IA HR
description:
To design and drive contemporary people and engagement interventions that build a future ready workforce, working as an individual contributor who conceptualises, curates and delivers initiatives end to end for the assigned business. To continuously map industry wide best practices in talent management and employee engagement, adapt them to the organisation's context and culture, and implement them seamlessly through platforms such as townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops, hackathons and other new age interventions. To strengthen employee experience, pride, capability and connect so that talent stays engaged, future skilled and aligned to the organisation's growth agenda. Responsibilities Designing and Driving People Initiatives for a Future Ready Workforce. Act as an individual contributor Engagement Partner who conceptualises, designs and drives the annual people engagement and talent management calendar for the assigned business. Build a deep understanding of the business agenda, workforce profile, capability gaps, culture priorities and employee sentiment to shape interventions that create a future ready workforce. Own the initiative lifecycle end to end - idea, design, stakeholder alignment, budget, communication, rollout, participation and post event impact measurement. Translate business and HR priorities into simple, scalable and repeatable people programs that can be run across locations and employee segments. Industry Best Practice Mapping and Adaptation. Continuously scan and benchmark industry wide best practices in engagement, talent management, employee experience, learning and future skilling across peer organisations, technology firms and start ups. Adapt and contextualise external best practices to the organisation's culture, employee demographics, business rhythm and cost discipline rather than adopting them as is. Pilot new ideas with defined success criteria, gather feedback, refine and scale the ones that work, while retiring interventions that do not add value. Ensure seamless implementation by building clear process documents, toolkits, communication assets and manager enablement material for every intervention. Flagship Engagement Platforms - Townhalls, Summits and People Connects. Plan and execute leadership townhalls including theme, content flow, leadership messaging, employee QA, logistics, attendance and post event feedback. Design and anchor summits and forums that showcase business achievements, innovation stories, customer impact and future roadmap for the workforce. Drive structured people connects such as skip level connects, new joiner connects, women connects, high potential connects, focus groups and pulse conversations to capture employee voice. Convert insights from connects, pulse surveys and culture surveys into clear action plans and follow through to closure with business and HR stakeholders. Career, Capability and Innovation Interventions. Design and run career workshops, career conversation frameworks, role based growth paths, internal mobility drives and mentoring circles that help employees see and build their future in the organisation. Conceptualise and deliver hackathons, ideathons, innovation challenges and learning sprints that build new age skills, encourage original thinking and create visible ownership. Partner with LD and business experts to curate future skilling journeys, certification drives, tech talks, knowledge sharing sessions and communities of practice. Strengthen rewards and recognition, onboarding and buddy programs, milestone celebrations and other employee experience moments that matter. Communication, Measurement and Governance. Build the internal communication narrative for people initiatives through bulletins, mailers, digital channels, leadership messages and campaign creatives. Define and track measurable outcomes for every intervention - participation, reach, feedback scores, engagement and culture survey movement, capability build and retention impact. Publish dashboards and review decks for leadership covering engagement calendar progress, action closures, employee sentiment themes and best practice adoption. Manage budgets, vendors and event partners with cost discipline, timelines and quality standards. The principal accountabilities of the role holder are expected to impact the organization from two perspectives: A. Business Indicators Timely and seamless execution of the annual engagement and talent management calendar Improvement in engagement, ESAT and culture survey scores for the assigned business Number of industry best practices mapped, piloted and successfully scaled within the organisation Participation, reach and feedback scores across townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops and hackathons Reduction in regrettable attrition and improvement in internal mobility and future skill readiness Adherence to budget, timelines and closure of actions arising from employee feedback B. Employees and Stakeholders Stronger employee connect, voice and sense of belonging across levels and locations Greater clarity on career paths, growth opportunities and skills required for the future Visible platforms for innovation, original thinking and recognition of contribution Higher pride in the organisation, the work and the leadership connect Enabled managers who can carry engagement and career conversations forward with their teams Key Decisions / Dimensions Design, theme, format and calendar of engagement and talent management interventions for the assigned business. Selection of industry best practices to be benchmarked, piloted, scaled or discontinued basis relevance and impact. Content flow, agenda and employee communication approach for townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops and hackathons. Recommendation on vendors, event partners, platforms and budget utilisation within approved limits. Identification of engagement hotspots, employee sentiment themes and the corrective action priorities to be taken up with business leaders. Metrics, feedback mechanisms and closure timelines to be used for measuring the success of each intervention. Major Challenges Establishing credibility as an individual contributor who designs and delivers large scale people initiatives without a direct team, relying purely on influence and stakeholder partnership. Adapting industry best practices to the organisation's context, culture and cost structure so that they land meaningfully instead of being seen as borrowed ideas. Keeping interventions fresh and relevant for a diverse and multi generational workforce spread across levels, locations and work models. Securing leadership time, manager participation and employee bandwidth for townhalls, summits, workshops and hackathons amidst demanding business timelines. Demonstrating measurable business and people impact of engagement interventions rather than event level participation alone. Balancing multiple concurrent initiatives, vendors and budgets while maintaining quality, timelines and a seamless employee experience. Required Qualifications and Experience a. Qualifications MBA / Post Graduate qualification in HR or related discipline preferred a. Work Experience 3 - 6 years of experience in employee engagement, talent management, employee experience, internal communication or HR partnering roles, preferably with exposure to technology or digital workforces. Demonstrated track record of independently designing and executing people initiatives such as townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops, hackathons, recognition programs and culture campaigns. Ability to benchmark industry best practices, contextualise them to the organisation and implement them seamlessly end to end. Strong conceptual thinking, storytelling and communication skills with the ability to craft content for leadership and large employee audiences. Project and event management skills covering planning, budgeting, vendor management, logistics and timelines. Comfort with people analytics, survey data, dashboards and digital engagement platforms to measure impact and drive decisions. High ownership, creativity, stakeholder management and the ability to deliver as an individual contributor through influence.

Overview: Provide materials and metallurgical engineering expertise across material selection, qualification, manufacturing processes, supplier assessments, failure analysis, and regulatory compliance for aerospace products. 
 Primary Responsibilities: Strong fundamentals in metallurgy and materials science with work experience in manufacturing process and special process for aerospace materials. Working knowledge on additive mfg. and composite materials will be beneficial. Shall have knowledge in interpretation of Industry material specification, process and specification (AMS, MIL, ASTM IS, BS, etc) and experience in laboratory characterization and testing of materials. Select and evaluate aerospace materials such as titanium, aluminum/aluminum-lithium, high-strength steels, nickel alloys, and advanced materials based on performance, producibility, and application requirements. Develop and execute material characterization and qualification programs, including A/B-basis design allowable and mechanical, fatigue, fracture, creep, and environmental testing. Conduct metallurgical evaluations and failure investigations for material/process non-conformances, production issues, test anomalies, and in-service failures. Hands-on experience with advanced characterization techniques such as SEM/EDS, EBSD, XRD, etc to evaluate microstructure, grain flow, hardness, UTM/tensile properties, coatings. Experience with TEM analysis will be beneficial. Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, AMS/ASTM specifications, AS9100, Nadcap, FAA, and customer requirements; support AMPL governance and audits. Provide technical guidance to Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and Supplier Engineering teams and resolve material/process compliance issues. Assess corrosion, galvanic compatibility, SCC, hydrogen embrittlement, fatigue, fracture, and environmental degradation risks. Develop technical standards, review methodologies, reports, white papers, and engineering recommendations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, supplier assessment, and technical communication skills. Experience with ERP/PLM systems such as SAP, Teamcenter, or equivalent. 
 Basic Qualifications: Ph.D./ Masters, degree in Materials Science/Metallurgical Engineering shall be bachelors degree in metallurgical/Materials engineering. 8 to12 years of relevant aerospace, defense, space, or high-performance manufacturing experience.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 JOB DESCRIPTION Principal Data Architect / Data Engineering AWS / Azure DEX Platform Experience 
 8–10 years Role type 
 Highly technical individual contributor / senior engineering role Platform 
 Enterprise DEX data platform on AWS, or equivalent Azure cloud data-platform experience Reporting line 
 Reports to the DEX Platform Lead Role purpose Design, build and continuously improve the DEX cloud data platform through deep hands-on engineering and technical architecture. The current platform is on AWS; strong AWS experience is preferred, while equivalent Azure cloud data-platform experience will also be considered. This role turns platform architecture and DEX 2.0 medallion goals into robust data pipelines, reusable platform patterns and production-ready implementations. The Principal Data Architect / Data Engineer will be a technical authority and hands-on contributor—working closely with the DEX Platform Lead, platform engineers and central AI / Cloud teams to deliver secure, scalable, reliable data capabilities and enable AI initiatives. This is an individual-contributor engineering role, not a people-management position. Platform context DEX ingests data from various on-premises and cloud-based source systems into cloud landing and processing layers. The current platform uses AWS services including Amazon S3, AWS EMR with Apache Spark, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Amazon Redshift, Amazon AppFlow and Amazon CloudWatch, alongside Apache Airflow, data quality and governance capabilities, masked views and data sharing. Candidates with equivalent Azure data-platform experience (for example, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Databricks / Spark, Microsoft Purview, Azure Data Factory and Synapse Analytics or equivalent services) will also be considered, with the ability to apply transferable cloud data-engineering concepts. The platform supports analytics, data marts, operational data products, regulatory reporting, BI and data science. The role contributes hands-on engineering and technical design across this lifecycle and the evolution toward DEX 2.0. Key responsibilities Hands-on data platform engineering Design, develop, test, tune and operate production-grade data pipelines and reusable components on AWS or Azure, with strong hands-on ownership from source ingestion through curated data and serving; apply equivalent cloud-native services and patterns to the DEX environment. Build distributed batch data processing using Apache Spark on AWS EMR or Azure Databricks / equivalent Spark services; optimize job logic, partitioning, file sizing, parallelism, shuffle, memory, compute utilization and runtime cost. Design Amazon S3 data layouts and lifecycle practices, including partition strategy, storage formats, encryption, retention, access controls and performance considerations. Implement and support ingestion integrations from on-premises and cloud-based systems using applicable push/pull, file transfer, JDBC, AWS AppFlow and comparable enterprise patterns. Develop and optimize Amazon Redshift data models and workloads, including SQL, schema design, data loading, performance tuning, workload management, secure access and data sharing. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog and related metadata capabilities to support discoverability, schema management, lineage and governed data access. The ideal candidate combines strong Python and full-stack engineering skills with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, LLM orchestration, and AI-enabled application development . You will work across the complete application lifecycle—from solution design and AI workflow development to backend APIs, user interfaces, cloud deployment, and production optimization. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, experimenting with emerging AI technologies, and turning AI capabilities into reliable, scalable business applications . Key Responsibilities AI & Agentic AI Engineering Design and implement LLM-powered applications, Agentic AI workflows, and multi-agent systems . Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent technologies . Develop RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using embeddings, vector search, document processing, and knowledge bases. Design effective prompting, tool calling, memory, agent orchestration, and workflow patterns . Integrate LLMs and enterprise AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, and other foundation-model platforms . Evaluate AI solutions for accuracy, relevance, latency, cost, reliability, and hallucination reduction . Implement appropriate guardrails, validation, observability, and human-in-the-loop mechanisms for enterprise AI applications. Full-Stack Application Development Design, develop, and maintain scalable AI-powered applications using Python, FastAPI, React.js, Next.js, and Node.js . Develop secure and scalable REST APIs, microservices, backend services, and AI orchestration layers . Build intuitive web interfaces for AI-driven capabilities such as AI assistants, chatbots, search, recommendations, analytics, and workflow automation . Integrate AI services seamlessly into existing enterprise applications and business workflows. Data & AI Infrastructure Design and implement data models and schemas using SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases . Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Azure AI Search, or equivalent technologies . Build data ingestion and processing pipelines for documents, structured data, and unstructured enterprise content. Implement embedding generation, semantic search, metadata filtering, chunking, indexing, and retrieval strategies. Work with data pipeline technologies such as Apache Airflow where applicable. Cloud & Production Engineering Deploy and operate AI applications on Azure and/or AWS . Build containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes . Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and production observability. Design applications for security, scalability, availability, performance, and cost efficiency . Integrate enterprise identity, authentication, authorization, and security controls into AI applications. Engineering & Collaboration Follow strong software engineering practices including Git, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and Agile development . Collaborate with product owners, architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI-enabled solutions. Contribute to technical design decisions, architecture discussions, and engineering standards. Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to apply them to real-world business problems. Required Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline . Strong hands-on experience with Python and modern Python frameworks. Strong experience building production-grade web applications and APIs using technologies such as FastAPI, Flask, Node.js/Express, React.js, or Next.js . Practical experience building applications using Generative AI and LLMs . Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, LLM orchestration, RAG, tool calling, and multi-agent workflows . Experience with one or more AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent . Experience working with vector databases / vector search technologies and embeddings. Strong understanding of SQL and relational databases ; experience with NoSQL databases is an advantage. Experience with REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing, and distributed application architectures . Experience with at least one major cloud platform, preferably Azure or AWS . Hands-on experience with Docker and familiarity with Kubernetes and CI/CD practices. Strong understanding of Git, Agile development, testing, debugging, and software engineering best practices . Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker , or equivalent AI platforms. Experience with LLM evaluation, AI observability, prompt evaluation, and model performance monitoring . Experience with fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, Hugging Face Transformers , or model adaptation techniques. Experience implementing AI security, guardrails, responsible AI, and enterprise data protection . Experience with MLOps / LLMOps practices. Contributions to open-source AI projects , technical communities, or personal AI/Agentic AI projects. Experience taking an AI prototype from POC MVP production . Exposure to enterprise domains such as finance, telecom, manufacturing, healthcare, or supply chain is an advantage. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will be expected to: Build AI solutions that move beyond POCs into reliable production applications . Develop reusable AI agents, RAG components, tools, and orchestration patterns . Deliver high-quality full-stack features across the AI, backend, data, and frontend layers . Improve AI application accuracy, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency . Help establish and evolve AI-first engineering practices across the development team.

title: Software Developer
description:
Software Quality Assurance Engineer Test Automation Job Title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer Test Automation
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Experience Level: As per organizational requirements
 Work Model: As per company policy
 Industry: IT / Software Development / Healthcare / Life Sciences About the Role We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Software Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer Test Automation to support the development, testing, and delivery of high-quality enterprise software solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in manual and automated testing, regression testing, API validation, SQL-based data verification, and software quality assurance processes across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). In this role, you will collaborate with developers, business analysts, technical product owners, and business stakeholders to define testing strategies, develop comprehensive test plans, identify and resolve defects, and ensure applications meet functional, technical, and business requirements before production deployment. The successful candidate will also contribute to test automation frameworks, continuous quality improvement initiatives, and engineering best practices across Agile delivery teams. Key Responsibilities Software Quality Assurance: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies aligned with enterprise coding standards, SDLC policies, and software quality requirements. Test Automation: Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts and frameworks using tools such as Mabl, QTP/UFT, Selenium WebDriver, and LoadRunner. Manual & Functional Testing: Create and execute test cases for functional, unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing to validate application functionality and reliability. Regression Testing: Build and maintain regression test suites, verify defect fixes, document test results, and ensure critical test scenarios pass before production releases. Test Planning & Execution: Lead the preparation and execution of test plans, test procedures, test scenarios, and self-documenting automated test cases for complex software projects. API Testing: Perform API testing using Postman and similar tools to validate RESTful and SOAP services, request and response structures, business logic, and integration workflows. Database Testing: Write SQL queries and database scripts to validate data integrity, analyze test results, investigate defects, and perform root-cause analysis across relational database systems. ODBC & Data Validation: Configure and utilize ODBC connections, database utilities, and query analysis tools to support cross-system data verification and test execution. User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Coordinate with end users and business stakeholders to plan and execute UAT, including alpha and beta testing, ensuring business requirements and acceptance criteria are satisfied. Defect Management: Identify, document, reproduce, track, and investigate software defects. Collaborate with development teams to determine root causes and validate corrective actions. CI/CD & Release Readiness: Support automated builds, testing, source control branching and merging, and release pipelines to ensure software quality throughout the deployment lifecycle. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with business analysts, developers, technical product owners, and QA teams to clarify requirements, define test artifacts, and maintain traceability between requirements and test coverage. Testing Strategy & Process Improvement: Establish testing approaches that address functional and non-functional requirements, improve test coverage, reduce delivery risks, and strengthen quality engineering practices. Technical Support & Mentoring: Support software upgrades, installations, and cross-functional initiatives while providing guidance to junior engineers on testing tools, automation frameworks, and QA best practices. Documentation & Reporting: Maintain test plans, test cases, automation scripts, defect reports, test execution results, and technical documentation to support knowledge sharing and operational continuity. Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline is required. Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred. Professional Experience Relevant professional experience in software quality assurance, software testing, test automation, or software engineering, commensurate with the positions assigned level. Hands-on experience designing and executing manual and automated test cases across functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing. Demonstrated experience with test automation tools, API testing, SQL-based data validation, database scripting, and defect investigation. Experience working within enterprise SDLC environments and Agile/Scrum delivery teams. Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD workflows and supporting production release readiness. Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other regulated industries is an advantage. Required Certifications Candidates must hold one of the following certifications: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) ISTQB Advanced Level Test Analyst Preferred Certifications Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE) American Society for Quality (ASQ) Mabl Certified Professional or Selenium WebDriver certification Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner Technical Skills & Expertise Testing Methodologies: Manual testing, test automation, functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, unit testing, end-to-end testing, UAT, alpha testing, and beta testing. You will use your expertise in C++, Python, advanced debugging, and test automation to improve product quality and reliability across Linux and Windows environments. WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO Succeed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent discipline. 8+ years of software development experience. title: Service Reliability Engineer
description:
WirelessCars Journey WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!
We are looking for a Service Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Operations team. As an SRE, you'll be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of our connected vehicle services running in production. You'll combine software engineering principles with operational excellence to troubleshoot complex production issues, improve system resilience, and drive continuous improvements across our cloud-native platform. Working closely with developers, architects, and other stakeholders, you'll play a key role in delivering highly reliable services that support millions of connected vehicles.
 We offer you High-tech company that offers an exciting working environment Involvement with Electric Vehicle services and products that drive sustainability. Tech fund where you pick your choice of tech tools. Flat organizational culture founded on trust and autonomy; at WirelessCar, you are not just a number. Hybrid Work-life balance What You'll Do As a Service Reliability Engineer, you will: Monitor and maintain production services to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance. Lead and participate in incident response, including major incidents, with a focus on minimizing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). Coordinate stakeholders during incidents and communicate status updates clearly and effectively. Perform root cause analyses (RCA) and facilitate post-incident reviews (PIR) to drive long-term improvements. Identify recurring issues and implement preventive measures through problem management. Support change management activities while ensuring operational stability and service continuity. Troubleshoot complex issues across cloud infrastructure, container platforms, distributed systems, databases, APIs, and backend applications. Collaborate closely with DevOps teams to improve observability, automation, and operational readiness. Continuously improve monitoring, alerting, operational processes, and system reliability. Ensure compliance with security requirements, operational standards, and agreed service level agreements (SLAs). Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to team schedules. What You'll Bring Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm. Solid understanding of AWS fundamentals. Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or OpenTelemetry (OTEL). Experience troubleshooting Kafka and distributed systems. Database troubleshooting experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, and/or MongoDB. REST API troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or Concourse. Experience troubleshooting Java backend applications and JVM-based services. Nice to Have MQTT experience. AWS EKS. Infrastructure automation using Ansible or scripting. Experience working with connected vehicle platforms or automotive backend systems. Operational Experience We're looking for someone with experience in, Incident Management. Major Incident Management. Acting as Incident Commander during critical incidents. Problem Management. Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Post Incident Reviews (PIR). Change Management. SLA-driven operations. ITIL-based service management. Experience with the following is considered an advantage: Service transition and knowledge transfer. SAFe or Agile delivery. Vendor coordination within multi-supplier environments. Who You Are You are someone who, Takes ownership and drives issues through to resolution. Has a structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting. Remains calm and focused during high-pressure production incidents. Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Can coordinate multiple teams during critical situations. Makes sound decisions, even when information is incomplete. Is passionate about continuous improvement and operational excellence. Enjoys coaching and mentoring colleagues. Demonstrates technical leadership and strong stakeholder management skills. Thrives in collaborative, cross-functional teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 5–9 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Operations, or Infrastructure Engineering. Professional working proficiency in English. Why Join WirelessCar? At WirelessCar, you'll work alongside talented colleagues from around the world in an open, collaborative, and innovative environment. We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, explore new technologies, and continuously grow their careers while building solutions that shape the future of connected mobility. If you're passionate about reliability, cloud technologies, and solving complex operational challenges at scale, we'd love to hear from you. Please note: Participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation is required for this position. Way of Working The work location for this role is our office in central Bangalore, India.
At WirelessCar we operate in a hybrid setup, combining the benefits of office collaboration with the flexibility of remote work.

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
ROLE SUMMARY The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable. The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix - Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions - ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks. The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations. 
 
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments. Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology. Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained. Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership. Integration and Data Engineering Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms. Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements. DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management. Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control. Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles. Vendor and Managed Service Delivery Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance. Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams. Enterprise Technology Alignment Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability. Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums. Organisational Leadership Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8-10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources. Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality. Compliance, Risk and Governance Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements. Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management. 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 Basic Qualifications Bachelors degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies. Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline. Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management. Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context. Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon). Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions. Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes. Recognised cloud or architecture certification. 
 PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. 
 
 NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Occasional travel up to 20% Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. 
 
 ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS 
 Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead. Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation. External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners. 
 
 RESOURCES MANAGED 
 Financial Accountability Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation
 Supervision Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleagues leadership. 
 Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

title: Delivery Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Head of Fixed-Price Delivery to lead our project delivery organization, improve project profitability, and establish a culture of accountability, engineering excellence, and predictable execution. The role will initially oversee approximately 1020 concurrent fixed-price projects and 25–50 delivery professionals, including project managers, technical leads, developers, QA engineers, and other specialists. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering experience with proven expertise in managing project budgets, controlling scope, leading multidisciplinary teams, and delivering profitable client engagements. This is a business-critical leadership position with direct reporting to the CEO and the authority to improve delivery processes, team structures, and performance. Key Responsibilities 1. Project Profitability and Financial Management • Take ownership of financial performance across the fixed-price delivery portfolio. • Establish project-level budgeting, effort tracking, cost forecasting, and profitability reporting. • Monitor actual costs against approved budgets and estimated costs to complete. • Identify potential overruns early and implement corrective actions. • Improve delivery margins through better planning, productivity, resource utilization, and execution discipline. • Work with Finance to establish accurate, consistent project margin reporting. 2. Project Planning and Execution 
 • Ensure projects begin with clear requirements, deliverables, acceptance criteria, milestones, and resource plans. • Validate delivery plans and identify unrealistic schedules, dependencies, and technical risks. • Establish standardized project governance and weekly delivery reviews. • Improve schedule predictability, milestone completion, and resource allocation. • Personally intervene in critical or underperforming projects and lead recovery efforts. 3. Scope and Change Management • Establish disciplined requirements management and scope control. • Ensure all changes are documented and assessed for their impact on effort, cost, and timelines. • Work with Sales and Account Management to obtain commercial approval for additional scope. • Prevent unapproved work from creating unnecessary delivery costs. • Ensure project teams understand and adhere to contractual scope and acceptance criteria. 4. Engineering Quality and Delivery Efficiency • Work closely with technical leads to review architecture, engineering estimates, and implementation approaches. • Identify technical decisions that may create rework, complexity, or delivery delays. • Improve development practices, code review discipline, testing, and quality assurance. • Reduce avoidable defects, repeated rework, and inefficient engineering practices. • Encourage practical adoption of AI-assisted development and automation where they demonstrably improve productivity and quality. 5. People Leadership and Accountability • Lead project managers, technical leads, and delivery teams. • Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, and accountability across projects. • Review the capabilities of existing delivery leaders and identify coaching, training, or organizational changes required. • Build a strong culture of ownership, transparency, and problem-solving. • Make resource allocation and performance management decisions to improve delivery outcomes. 6. Client Communication and Satisfaction • Ensure proactive communication on project progress, risks, and changes. • Intervene in escalations and manage difficult delivery situations constructively. • Improve client confidence through transparent reporting and predictable execution. • Protect delivery quality and client relationships while improving project profitability. Required Experience and Qualifications 
 • Significant experience in software engineering and technical project delivery, preferably 12+ years. • At least 5 years in a leadership role managing multiple software delivery projects. • Demonstrated experience managing fixed-price software development projects with direct financial accountability. • Strong understanding of project budgeting, gross margins, resource costs, cost-to- complete forecasting, and scope management. • Experience leading project managers and technical leads across multiple engagements. • Sound technical understanding of custom web applications, SaaS platforms, APIs, databases, mobile applications, and modern software architectures. • Familiarity with AI, GenAI, automation, or data engineering project delivery. • Experience working directly with international clients. • Strong analytical, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Highly Preferred • Experience in an outsourced software product development, digital engineering, or IT services company. • Proven record of improving fixed-price project margins or recovering troubled projects. • Experience establishing delivery governance and financial controls where processes were previously immature. • Ability to challenge engineering assumptions without unnecessarily micromanaging technical teams. • Experience managing distributed engineering teams and working across multiple technology stacks.

You will design high-performance microservices and APIs, orchestrate streaming and batch pipelines, automate cloud-native infrastructure, and solve complex distributed-systems challenges-such as multi-replica race conditions, state synchronization, and sub-second data processing. Integrate foundational AI/LLM models and external services (e.g., AWS Bedrock). Define resilient service interfaces, API schemas, and data contracts between internal engineering teams. Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management Design robust state-management patterns to handle high-concurrency race conditions across worker pools, message queues, and database rows. Implement distributed synchronization mechanisms (e.g., distributed locks/mutexes, idempotency keys, and optimistic/pessimistic locking strategies). Ensure reliable execution, deduplication, and zero-data-loss guarantees across asynchronous task workers. Data Infrastructure & Orchestration Develop and maintain scalable job orchestration workflows for streaming and batch processing using Celery, Dagster, or Apache Airflow. Design, optimize, and maintain relational datastores (PostgreSQL) and in-memory caches (Redis). Build modern analytical pipelines and data storage layers leveraging Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns. Enforce end-to-end data quality, governance, schema evolution, and lineage across platforms. Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & CI/CD Own, automate, and maintain cloud environments on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (CDKTF / Terraform). Containerize services with Docker and manage deployments, auto-scaling (HPA), and load-balancing on Kubernetes (k8s) using Helm. Build, maintain, and optimize secure GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment pipelines. Observability & Reliability Engineering Ensure production uptime, high availability, and performance SLA/SLO benchmarks. Build deep observability, tracing, and alerting stacks across all microservices and data pipelines using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog. Required Qualifications & Experience 5+ years of experience building and operating production backend services, distributed systems, or large-scale data platforms. Expertise in Python: Deep proficiency in the modern Python ecosystem (FastAPI, uv, async I/O, typing). Database & Caching Mastery: Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL (query optimization, ACID transactions, locking mechanisms, indexing) and Redis (caching strategies, pub/sub, distributed locks). Container & Cloud Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s), Docker, Helm, and AWS cloud architecture. Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Proven track record with CDKTF (Cloud Development Kit for Terraform) or Terraform. Workflow Orchestration: Production experience with pipeline orchestrators such as Dagster, Celery, or Apache Airflow. Observability: Practical experience instrumenting systems with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog. Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Clear understanding of race conditions, deadlocks, consensus primitives, and message-queue semantics. Good to Have Experience with Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and CDC (Change Data Capture) via Debezium/Kafka. Exposure to MLOps workflows (MLflow, Feature Stores, embedding pipelines). Familiarity with consensus protocols and distributed coordination systems (Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd). Frontend familiarity with React, TypeScript, or Tailwind CSS. Active contributions to open-source software.

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
ROLE SUMMARY The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable. The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix - Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions - ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks. The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations. 
 
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments. Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology. Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained. Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership. Integration and Data Engineering Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms. Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements. DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management. Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control. Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles. Vendor and Managed Service Delivery Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance. Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams. Enterprise Technology Alignment Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability. Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums. Organisational Leadership Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8-10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources. Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality. Compliance, Risk and Governance Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements. Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management. 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 Basic Qualifications Bachelors degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies. Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline. Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management. Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context. Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon). description:

 Client: Straive
 Job Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
 Work Mode: Hybrid – 3 days per week in office
 Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
 Experience: 6–16 years preferred
 Notice Period: Immediate to 60 days
 Openings: 1
 Tentative Compensation: 2.5–3 lakh per month, depending on current CTC, experience and technical fit Job Overview We are looking for a hands-on Senior Solution Engineer with strong expertise across Java engineering, AWS cloud architecture, Snowflake, data engineering and AI/GenAI integration. This is a technically demanding engineering role for someone who can design, build, deploy and own production-grade applications and data solutions—not simply coordinate development or work on isolated application features. The ideal candidate combines strong Java/Spring Boot engineering with practical AWS production experience, Snowflake-based data processing, AI/GenAI integration and modern AI-assisted engineering practices. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to make technical decisions, troubleshoot production issues, optimise systems and deliver reliable solutions across application and data layers. Key Responsibilities 1. Java Application Engineering Design, develop and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java, Spring Boot and RESTful APIs. Build scalable, secure and maintainable backend services. Apply sound object-oriented design, exception handling, automated testing and performance optimisation. Diagnose complex application issues and take ownership of production defects. 2. AWS Cloud Engineering Design, deploy and support production workloads on AWS. Demonstrate practical knowledge of AWS architecture, IAM, networking, security, monitoring and observability. Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, application deployment and runtime issues. Make informed decisions about reliability, scalability, performance and cost optimisation. 3. Snowflake and Data Engineering Develop and optimise Snowflake SQL queries, data models and data processing workflows. Work with data ingestion, transformation, integration and processing pipelines. Handle complex SQL, performance tuning, data validation and troubleshooting. Apply appropriate practices for data access, governance, reliability and efficient processing. 4. AI/GenAI Engineering Integrate AI/GenAI capabilities into applications and enterprise workflows. Work with AI services, APIs and relevant application integration patterns. Understand practical implementation considerations such as response quality, latency, security, reliability and evaluation. Contribute to production-ready AI-enabled solutions rather than limiting work to demonstrations or prototypes. 5. AI-Assisted Software Engineering Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or Claude to improve engineering productivity. Apply these tools to code generation, refactoring, debugging, testing and documentation. Review and validate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability. Demonstrate responsible use of AI tools within an established software engineering workflow. 6. CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and Production Ownership Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines. Work with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and repeatable deployment practices. Support automated testing, release management, observability and production troubleshooting. Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions. Take end-to-end ownership of delivered solutions, including operational stability and ongoing improvements. Mandatory Technical Requirements — Hard Screening Candidates must demonstrate practical, hands-on experience in the following areas: 1. Java and Backend Engineering Strong Java development experience, preferably with Spring Boot and REST APIs. Ability to explain application architecture, design decisions, debugging and production troubleshooting. 2. AWS Production Depth Real-world experience deploying and supporting production workloads on AWS. Practical understanding of architecture, IAM, security, networking, monitoring and troubleshooting. Basic AWS familiarity or certification without production experience is insufficient. 3. Snowflake Hands-on experience with Snowflake, including SQL, data processing, modelling or pipeline integration. Ability to explain actual project contributions and data-related engineering challenges. 4. AI/GenAI Practical experience integrating AI/GenAI into applications or workflows. Ability to explain the implementation, integration approach and production considerations. 5. AI-Assisted Engineering Practical use of AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude, Cursor or GitHub Copilot. Ability to explain how these tools were used in actual engineering work and how generated code was validated. 6. CI/CD and IaC Hands-on experience with automated build, test and deployment pipelines. Practical exposure to Infrastructure as Code and repeatable deployment processes. 7. Data Engineering Experience working with SQL, data integration, data transformation or data processing pipelines. Ability to troubleshoot data quality, processing or performance issues. 8. Production Ownership Demonstrable responsibility for applications or workloads running in production. Experience with monitoring, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, reliability and performance improvement. Important: These requirements are intended as hard technical gates. Candidates with experience limited to Java development alone, AWS certification alone, basic Snowflake exposure, AI experimentation without implementation, or development without production ownership may not be shortlisted. Soft Screening Requirements Candidates should also meet the following role and working requirements: Comfortable working from the Mumbai office 3 days per week . Available for a full-time, permanent position. Notice period between immediate and 60 days. Able to communicate technical decisions, implementation details and production issues clearly. Comfortable working independently and collaborating with application, data and infrastructure teams. Able to explain personal contributions to projects rather than relying solely on team-level accomplishments. Willing to participate in a detailed technical evaluation covering the mandatory skills. Good-to-Have Skills The following strengthen a candidate's profile but do not replace the mandatory requirements: AWS Bedrock or other managed AI services. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents and LLM application patterns. AI evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI implementation. Advanced Snowflake optimisation, data governance and data-sharing practices. Advanced AWS architecture, observability and cost optimisation. Advanced Java/Spring Boot architecture and distributed systems. Strong automated testing, secure coding and application performance engineering. Experience delivering AI-enabled, data-intensive enterprise applications. Experience and Eligibility Candidates with 6–16 years of experience are preferred. Candidates with 4.5 years or more may be considered as an exception only if they demonstrate strong evidence across all mandatory technical requirements . Meeting the minimum experience threshold does not automatically qualify a candidate. Application Instructions Please apply with an updated CV that clearly highlights: Java/Spring Boot project experience. Production AWS architecture and troubleshooting experience. Snowflake implementation and data engineering contributions. AI/GenAI integration projects. Practical use of AI-assisted development tools. CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and production ownership. Current location, notice period and willingness to work in Mumbai under the hybrid arrangement. Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific projects, architecture decisions, technical challenges and their individual contributions during screening. Only candidates who meet the mandatory technical requirements and can demonstrate hands-on engineering depth will be shortlisted.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Head of Fixed-Price Delivery to lead our project delivery organization, improve project profitability, and establish a culture of accountability, engineering excellence, and predictable execution. The role will initially oversee approximately 1020 concurrent fixed-price projects and 25–50 delivery professionals, including project managers, technical leads, developers, QA engineers, and other specialists. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering experience with proven expertise in managing project budgets, controlling scope, leading multidisciplinary teams, and delivering profitable client engagements. This is a business-critical leadership position with direct reporting to the CEO and the authority to improve delivery processes, team structures, and performance. Key Responsibilities 1. Project Profitability and Financial Management • Take ownership of financial performance across the fixed-price delivery portfolio. • Establish project-level budgeting, effort tracking, cost forecasting, and profitability reporting. • Monitor actual costs against approved budgets and estimated costs to complete. • Identify potential overruns early and implement corrective actions. • Improve delivery margins through better planning, productivity, resource utilization, and execution discipline. • Work with Finance to establish accurate, consistent project margin reporting. 2. Project Planning and Execution 
 • Ensure projects begin with clear requirements, deliverables, acceptance criteria, milestones, and resource plans. • Validate delivery plans and identify unrealistic schedules, dependencies, and technical risks. • Establish standardized project governance and weekly delivery reviews. • Improve schedule predictability, milestone completion, and resource allocation. • Personally intervene in critical or underperforming projects and lead recovery efforts. 3. Scope and Change Management • Establish disciplined requirements management and scope control. • Ensure all changes are documented and assessed for their impact on effort, cost, and timelines. • Work with Sales and Account Management to obtain commercial approval for additional scope. • Prevent unapproved work from creating unnecessary delivery costs. • Ensure project teams understand and adhere to contractual scope and acceptance criteria. 4. Engineering Quality and Delivery Efficiency • Work closely with technical leads to review architecture, engineering estimates, and implementation approaches. • Identify technical decisions that may create rework, complexity, or delivery delays. • Improve development practices, code review discipline, testing, and quality assurance. • Reduce avoidable defects, repeated rework, and inefficient engineering practices. • Encourage practical adoption of AI-assisted development and automation where they demonstrably improve productivity and quality. 5. People Leadership and Accountability • Lead project managers, technical leads, and delivery teams. • Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, and accountability across projects. • Review the capabilities of existing delivery leaders and identify coaching, training, or organizational changes required. • Build a strong culture of ownership, transparency, and problem-solving. • Make resource allocation and performance management decisions to improve delivery outcomes. 6. Client Communication and Satisfaction • Ensure proactive communication on project progress, risks, and changes. • Intervene in escalations and manage difficult delivery situations constructively. • Improve client confidence through transparent reporting and predictable execution. • Protect delivery quality and client relationships while improving project profitability. Required Experience and Qualifications 
 • Significant experience in software engineering and technical project delivery, preferably 12+ years. • At least 5 years in a leadership role managing multiple software delivery projects. • Demonstrated experience managing fixed-price software development projects with direct financial accountability. • Strong understanding of project budgeting, gross margins, resource costs, cost-to- complete forecasting, and scope management. • Experience leading project managers and technical leads across multiple engagements. • Sound technical understanding of custom web applications, SaaS platforms, APIs, databases, mobile applications, and modern software architectures. • Familiarity with AI, GenAI, automation, or data engineering project delivery. • Experience working directly with international clients. • Strong analytical, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Highly Preferred • Experience in an outsourced software product development, digital engineering, or IT services company. • Proven record of improving fixed-price project margins or recovering troubled projects. • Experience establishing delivery governance and financial controls where processes were previously immature. • Ability to challenge engineering assumptions without unnecessarily micromanaging technical teams. • Experience managing distributed engineering teams and working across multiple technology stacks.
