title: Immediate Opening - Senior AI SecOps Engineer
description:
1. Role Overview We are seeking a Senior AI SecOps Engineer to design and establish a practical security framework for enterprise AI agents and LLM-powered applications. The role focuses on identifying AI-specific security risks, defining and implementing security controls, establishing agent governance, and validating that controls operate as intended. The engineer will work closely with cloud security, application engineering, platform, and governance teams to translate security requirements into implementable controls and operational practices. This is a hands-on consulting role requiring a balance of security architecture, engineering implementation, risk assessment, and technical documentation. The successful candidate will establish the initial framework, develop reference implementations for selected controls, validate them against representative AI use cases, and enable the customer's engineering and security teams to maintain and extend the solution. Engagement details Duration: 6 months Time commitment: Approximately 60100 hours per month Engagement type: Part-time consulting / contract Primary focus: AI agent security, security controls, governance, and risk management Working model: Collaboration with the customer's existing engineering, cloud security, and governance teams 2. Key Responsibilities A. AI Agent Security Architecture Assess the security posture of existing or planned AI agents and LLM-powered applications. Develop threat models covering prompt injection, unauthorized tool execution, excessive agent permissions, sensitive-data exposure, insecure integrations, and untrusted inputs or outputs. Define security boundaries and trust relationships between agents, users, tools, APIs, enterprise data sources, and external services. Establish security patterns for agent identity, authentication, authorization, secrets management, least-privilege access, and controlled tool execution. Define appropriate approval and escalation requirements for high-impact or sensitive agent actions. Align AI-specific security controls with the customer's existing cloud and application security architecture. B. Security Controls and Reference Implementations Define a reusable baseline of security controls for enterprise AI agents, categorized by risk, autonomy, data access, and business impact. Establish implementation patterns for access control, tool permissions, input/output validation, sensitive-data handling, and policy enforcement. Develop or configure reference implementations for selected controls within the customer's existing technology stack. Define secure integration patterns for agent frameworks, APIs, enterprise systems, and relevant agent communication protocols. Evaluate controls against realistic attack scenarios and document limitations, residual risks, and remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineering teams to incorporate security requirements into the AI application development lifecycle. C. AI Governance and Risk Management Define an inventory model for AI agents, capturing ownership, purpose, business criticality, data access, connected tools, permissions, and autonomy level. Establish a risk-classification approach to determine appropriate security requirements for different agent types. Define minimum security requirements for agent onboarding, deployment, modification, and retirement. Map relevant AI security controls to established security and risk-management frameworks, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and OWASP guidance for LLM applications, where applicable. Establish processes for recording exceptions, assigning control ownership, tracking remediation, and maintaining audit evidence. Support security and governance stakeholders in defining accountability and review processes for high-risk agents. D. Security Validation and Testing Develop a practical test plan to validate security controls against representative AI agent threat scenarios. Conduct or coordinate security testing covering prompt injection, unauthorized tool calls, privilege misuse, sensitive-data leakage, and policy bypass attempts. Validate authorization boundaries, tool restrictions, data-access controls, and approval mechanisms. Document test results, control effectiveness, identified gaps, and remediation actions. Recommend improvements based on test outcomes and residual risk. Establish repeatable security validation procedures that the customer's engineering team can use for future AI agent deployments. E. Operational Readiness and Handover Define security review procedures for new and modified AI agents. Develop operational runbooks for security assessments, control exceptions, remediation tracking, and escalation. Establish a practical process for reviewing agent permissions, security configurations, and compliance with the approved security baseline. Transfer knowledge, implementation artefacts, and operational responsibilities to the customer's designated teams. Provide recommendations for future improvements to the AI agent security framework. 3. Expected Deliverables Deliverables will be prioritized and agreed with the customer during the engagement kickoff. Deliverable Expected outcome AI Security Assessment Documented architecture review, threat model, risk register, and prioritized recommendations AI Agent Inventory and Risk Model Reusable inventory schema, ownership model, risk classification, and security requirements AI Agent Security Baseline Documented minimum controls and implementation guidance for different risk levels Security Reference Implementations Working examples of selected controls integrated with representative agents or applications Security Validation Pack Test scenarios, execution evidence, findings, and remediation recommendations Governance and Evidence Framework Control mapping, exception tracking, evidence requirements, and review procedures Operational Handover Pack Runbooks, architecture documentation, implementation artefacts, and knowledge-transfer materials Executive Summary Final assessment of security posture, outstanding risks, completed deliverables, and recommended next steps The scope of reference implementations and production integrations will depend on the existing environment, platform readiness, access, and available engineering support. 4. Required Qualifications Experience 8+ years of overall experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, or security engineering. 5+ years of relevant hands-on experience implementing or assessing security controls in enterprise applications, cloud environments, or distributed systems. Demonstrable experience with security architecture, threat modelling, identity and access management, and secure system integrations. Hands-on experience securing at least one production LLM application, AI agent, or comparable AI-enabled system. Substantial implementation experience in AI security research or security engineering may also be considered. Experience translating security requirements into working controls, implementation guidance, and testable acceptance criteria. Experience collaborating with application engineers, platform teams, security stakeholders, and technical leadership. Technical Skills AI and application security Understanding of LLM and agent architectures, including model interactions, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and external system integrations. Understanding of AI-specific threats, including prompt injection, insecure tool execution, sensitive-data disclosure, excessive agency, and trust-boundary failures. Ability to assess agent permissions, authorization boundaries, data access, and the potential impact of autonomous actions. Knowledge of AI security testing, guardrails, and the limitations of prompt-based safeguards. Cloud, identity, and security engineering Strong understanding of IAM, least-privilege access, workload identity, secrets management, API security, and secure integration patterns. Experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Understanding of encryption, access control, audit requirements, vulnerability management, and secure software development practices. Ability to design and validate security controls that complement existing enterprise security tools and processes. Governance and risk management Ability to translate security risks into control requirements, risk classifications, evidence requirements, and remediation plans. Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks, such as NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and relevant organizational security standards. Ability to document risk assessments, control mappings, exceptions, testing evidence, and remediation plans. Integration and implementation Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and common integration patterns. Ability to review implementation code, troubleshoot integrations, and work with engineering teams to validate security controls. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and security testing in the software development lifecycle. 5. Desirable Qualifications Experience with agent frameworks, agent orchestration platforms, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or similar tool-integration mechanisms. Experience with AI security evaluation tools, red-teaming approaches, policy enforcement, or agent security testing solutions. Experience with cloud-native AI services and enterprise LLM platforms. Experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments. Familiarity with Python, SQL, or scripting for security testing and automation. Experience integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines. Python, SQL, and specific data-platform technologies are not mandatory requirements unless the agreed implementation scope explicitly requires custom development. 6. Candidate Expectations The successful candidate is expected to: Operate as a hands-on security engineer rather than a documentation-only consultant. Make pragmatic recommendations that can be implemented within the customer's existing architecture and constraints. Distinguish immediate security priorities from longer-term improvements. Demonstrate how proposed controls work through reference implementations, configuration, or repeatable tests. Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, residual risks, and dependencies clearly. Work independently while coordinating with the customer's engineering and security teams. Produce reusable documentation and implementation artefacts that the customer can maintain after the engagement. Deliver against an agreed backlog, milestones, and acceptance criteria within the available consulting hours. Ideal candidate profile: A senior cloud or application security engineer with demonstrable AI/LLM security implementation experience, strong security architecture fundamentals, and the ability to turn security requirements into working controls and repeatable validation tests.

We're the world's leading data, insights, and consulting company; we shape the brands of tomorrow by better understanding people everywhere. Our Functions teams are right at the centre of our business, making sure we can always get better, every day. Supporting the business with things like Marketing, Human Resources, Finance, Legal and Technology, our Functions colleagues are skilled professionals whose role it is to ensure we continue to become an indispensable partner to brands everywhere. Job Summary The People Systems & Data SME Analyst is responsible for maximizing the value of people technology solutions to enhance service delivery, operational efficiency, and user experience. This role partners closely with People Operations, HR functions, and Technology teams to ensure alignment between systems, processes, and business objectives while driving continuous improvement through data-driven insights. Key Responsibilities Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for People technologies, including Workday, ServiceNow, and other relevant platforms, providing expert guidance and support for technology-enabled initiatives. Drive technology adoption and identify opportunities to improve service delivery, user experience, and operational effectiveness. Partner with Technology teams to align business requirements with system capabilities, ensuring successful delivery of strategic initiatives and projects. Lead data analysis and business improvement initiatives to identify trends, patterns, risks, gaps, and opportunities across People Operations processes and policies. Conduct research and benchmarking on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to inform strategy and solution development. Assess current and future technology needs, recommending innovative solutions that support People Operations and broader business objectives. Provide data-driven recommendations and guidance to HR teams, operational specialists, managers, and business leaders on system-related matters and best practices. Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Support the development of team capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, and mentoring of junior colleagues. Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, technology solutions, reporting capabilities, and analytical methodologies. Ensure data governance, data quality, compliance, and confidentiality standards are maintained across all activities. Key Skills and Experience Strong expertise in People technology platforms such as Workday, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise HR systems. Experience driving technology adoption, process improvement, and service optimization initiatives. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights. Demonstrated ability to conduct research, benchmarking, and trend analysis to support strategic decision-making. Experience managing stakeholders and collaborating across HR, Operations, Technology, and business functions. Ability to influence outcomes and align business and technology priorities. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences. Experience coaching, mentoring, and supporting the development of team members. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment. High degree of professionalism, integrity, discretion, and commitment to data confidentiality and governance. Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and operational excellence. Preferred Experience Experience supporting global HR or People Operations environments. Knowledge of HR processes, workforce data, reporting, governance, and compliance requirements. Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or similar analytics platforms. Experience participating in system implementations, enhancements, integrations, or transformation programs. Country India

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
ROLE SUMMARY The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable. The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix - Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions - ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks. The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations. 
 
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments. Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology. Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained. Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership. Integration and Data Engineering Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms. Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements. DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management. Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control. Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles. Vendor and Managed Service Delivery Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance. Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams. Enterprise Technology Alignment Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability. Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums. Organisational Leadership Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8-10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources. Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality. Compliance, Risk and Governance Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements. Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management. 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 Basic Qualifications Bachelors degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies. Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline. Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management. Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context. Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon). Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions. Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes. Recognised cloud or architecture certification. 
 PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. 
 
 NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Occasional travel up to 20% Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. 
 
 ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS 
 Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead. Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation. External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners. 
 
 RESOURCES MANAGED 
 Financial Accountability Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation
 Supervision Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleagues leadership. 
 Work Location Assignment: Hybrid
 To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers . Information & Business Tech

title: Data Scientist - AI Modelling
description:
About the Role
 The FCC DnA team is seeking an experienced Data Scientist to join our AI Modeling team and develop scalable Machine Learning, statistical and AI solutions. This role is ideal for a hands-on Data Scientist who can independently translate business problems into modeling problems, evaluate multiple analytical approaches and recommend solutions based on data, statistical evidence and business requirements. You will work across Statistical Modeling, Machine Learning, NLP and Generative AI while partnering with Product, Engineering and Business teams to take solutions from experimentation toward production. We are looking for someone who goes beyond building a model and can clearly explain why a particular modeling approach was selected, how it was validated and what its limitations are.
 Key Responsibilities Translate business problems and requirements into appropriate analytical and modeling approaches. Independently design, develop and evaluate statistical and Machine Learning models. Establish appropriate baseline and challenger models and objectively compare alternative approaches. Perform exploratory analysis, feature engineering, feature selection and data-quality assessment. Define appropriate model evaluation metrics based on the business problem and the cost of different types of errors. Apply cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, out-of-sample testing and other robust validation techniques. Conduct detailed error analysis, sensitivity analysis and model diagnostics. Identify and address issues such as data leakage, class imbalance, multicollinearity, sampling bias and overfitting. Evaluate model explainability, stability and performance trade-offs. Clearly document model methodology, assumptions, limitations and validation results. Partner with Engineering and MLOps teams to transition models from experimentation into production. Support model monitoring, performance tracking and drift analysis after deployment. Build reusable modeling components and frameworks that can be leveraged across multiple use cases. Contribute to NLP, Generative AI, RAG and hybrid AI solutions where appropriate. Mentor junior Data Scientists and conduct code and model reviews. Communicate modeling recommendations and trade-offs effectively to business, Product and technical stakeholders.
 Required Qualifications
 Experience Approximately 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling or Applied AI. Demonstrated experience independently developing and validating predictive models. Experience working across the model development lifecycle from data exploration through validation and productionization. Experience working with cross-functional Product, Engineering and Business teams. Statistical & Modeling Skills Strong understanding of statistical inference, probability, hypothesis testing and experimental design. Strong hands-on experience with regression, classification, tree-based models, ensemble methods and other Machine Learning techniques. Experience with algorithms such as logistic/linear regression, random forest, gradient boosting, XGBoost/LightGBM or comparable techniques. Strong understanding of feature engineering, feature selection and model diagnostics. Experience designing benchmark, baseline and challenger models. Strong understanding of model evaluation and the ability to select metrics appropriate to the business problem. Understanding of bias-variance trade-offs, sampling bias, class imbalance, data leakage and model stability. Experience with explainability techniques such as feature importance, SHAP or similar approaches. Ability to assess trade-offs between predictive performance, interpretability, complexity and maintainability. Technical Skills Strong Python and modern Data Science ecosystem experience. Strong SQL and data manipulation skills. Experience developing production-quality, reusable modeling code. Familiarity with APIs and frameworks such as FastAPI. Familiarity with Git, Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms such as Azure/AWS and MLOps practices. Experience with model deployment, monitoring and versioning is preferred. Experience with NLP, Generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, RAG or Agentic AI is desirable and will enable contribution across broader AI initiatives.
 We Are Looking for Individuals Who Ask which modeling approach is most appropriate for the problem and can explain why. Challenge assumptions rather than automatically selecting the most complex algorithm. Are comfortable working with ambiguous business problems and defining a structured analytical approach. Balance experimentation with analytical rigor and production considerations. Take ownership of modeling workstreams and independently drive them to completion. Clearly articulate model performance, assumptions, limitations and business implications. Mentor junior team members and raise the quality of modeling practices around them. Collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering and business stakeholders. Remain current with developments across statistical modeling, Machine Learning and broader Applied AI. Education Bachelors or Masters degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Economics or another quantitative discipline. Our Interview Practices To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we re getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Head of Fixed-Price Delivery to lead our project delivery organization, improve project profitability, and establish a culture of accountability, engineering excellence, and predictable execution. The role will initially oversee approximately 1020 concurrent fixed-price projects and 25–50 delivery professionals, including project managers, technical leads, developers, QA engineers, and other specialists. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering experience with proven expertise in managing project budgets, controlling scope, leading multidisciplinary teams, and delivering profitable client engagements. This is a business-critical leadership position with direct reporting to the CEO and the authority to improve delivery processes, team structures, and performance. Key Responsibilities 1. Project Profitability and Financial Management • Take ownership of financial performance across the fixed-price delivery portfolio. • Establish project-level budgeting, effort tracking, cost forecasting, and profitability reporting. • Monitor actual costs against approved budgets and estimated costs to complete. • Identify potential overruns early and implement corrective actions. • Improve delivery margins through better planning, productivity, resource utilization, and execution discipline. • Work with Finance to establish accurate, consistent project margin reporting. 2. Project Planning and Execution 
 • Ensure projects begin with clear requirements, deliverables, acceptance criteria, milestones, and resource plans. • Validate delivery plans and identify unrealistic schedules, dependencies, and technical risks. • Establish standardized project governance and weekly delivery reviews. • Improve schedule predictability, milestone completion, and resource allocation. • Personally intervene in critical or underperforming projects and lead recovery efforts. 3. Scope and Change Management • Establish disciplined requirements management and scope control. • Ensure all changes are documented and assessed for their impact on effort, cost, and timelines. • Work with Sales and Account Management to obtain commercial approval for additional scope. • Prevent unapproved work from creating unnecessary delivery costs. • Ensure project teams understand and adhere to contractual scope and acceptance criteria. 4. Engineering Quality and Delivery Efficiency • Work closely with technical leads to review architecture, engineering estimates, and implementation approaches. • Identify technical decisions that may create rework, complexity, or delivery delays. • Improve development practices, code review discipline, testing, and quality assurance. • Reduce avoidable defects, repeated rework, and inefficient engineering practices. • Encourage practical adoption of AI-assisted development and automation where they demonstrably improve productivity and quality. 5. People Leadership and Accountability • Lead project managers, technical leads, and delivery teams. • Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, and accountability across projects. • Review the capabilities of existing delivery leaders and identify coaching, training, or organizational changes required. • Build a strong culture of ownership, transparency, and problem-solving. • Make resource allocation and performance management decisions to improve delivery outcomes. 6. Client Communication and Satisfaction • Ensure proactive communication on project progress, risks, and changes. • Intervene in escalations and manage difficult delivery situations constructively. • Improve client confidence through transparent reporting and predictable execution. • Protect delivery quality and client relationships while improving project profitability. Required Experience and Qualifications 
 • Significant experience in software engineering and technical project delivery, preferably 12+ years. • At least 5 years in a leadership role managing multiple software delivery projects. • Demonstrated experience managing fixed-price software development projects with direct financial accountability. • Strong understanding of project budgeting, gross margins, resource costs, cost-to- complete forecasting, and scope management. • Experience leading project managers and technical leads across multiple engagements. • Sound technical understanding of custom web applications, SaaS platforms, APIs, databases, mobile applications, and modern software architectures. • Familiarity with AI, GenAI, automation, or data engineering project delivery. • Experience working directly with international clients. • Strong analytical, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Highly Preferred • Experience in an outsourced software product development, digital engineering, or IT services company. • Proven record of improving fixed-price project margins or recovering troubled projects. • Experience establishing delivery governance and financial controls where processes were previously immature. • Ability to challenge engineering assumptions without unnecessarily micromanaging technical teams. • Experience managing distributed engineering teams and working across multiple technology stacks.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About The Role 
 DexCare is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build the AI systems behind our products. Your primary focus will be Optimize AI, which ingests, structures, and governs complex healthcare scheduling rules and institutional knowledge into a single, verified source of truth. The core problem is turning large volumes of messy, inconsistent, and constantly changing operational knowledge into structured knowledge that people and AI agents can rely on to make decisions. 
 This is a hands-on, mid-level role. You will build, ship, and own production ML and LLM systems, working closely with product, engineering, and data teams. Our AI products share a common foundation, so you will also work across them, including Mila, our patient-facing agents, as priorities shift. You will join a well-established team early in the build-out of DexCares AI capabilities, with large health systems already using our products. If you enjoy taking ML systems from prototype to production and making them accurate, reliable, and fast, we’d love to hear from you. 
 What You’ll Do Build systems that ingest unstructured and inconsistent source material, such as policies, protocols, rules, and spreadsheets, and turn it into structured, versioned, and verified knowledge. Build extraction, normalization, and validation pipelines using LLMs and classical techniques; detect conflicts, gaps, and stale information, and route uncertain cases to human review. Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that give downstream systems and agents accurate, grounded, and traceable answers with low latency. Build, ship, and maintain components of the agentic systems that act on this knowledge, including orchestration, tool calling, and state management. Build evaluation for the systems you ship: ground-truth datasets, accuracy metrics, regression tests that run before every release, LLM-as-judge and human review, and monitoring of quality in production. Diagnose and improve accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost of ML systems in production. Build components that can be reused across DexCare’s AI products, and contribute to other products as priorities shift. Follow ML lifecycle best practices: versioning of models, prompts, datasets, and knowledge; deployment; monitoring; and retraining. Handle patient and customer data in line with HIPAA and DexCare’s privacy and security standards. 
 What You’ll Bring 5+ years of experience in machine learning or software engineering, including building and running production ML systems. Experience building systems that extract, structure, and verify knowledge from unstructured sources, such as documents, policies, or operational data, with measurable accuracy. Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based agentic systems to production, including orchestration, tool calling, and handling failures with retries and fallbacks. Experience building retrieval systems and improving their accuracy and latency. Experience evaluating ML and LLM systems: building eval datasets, defining metrics, and using the results to decide what ships. Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, code review, and API design. Familiarity with MLOps practices and at least one major cloud platform. Clear communication and the ability to work across product, engineering, and data teams, including across time zones. Comfort working in ambiguous problem spaces where requirements and data evolve. 
 Preferred Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Google ADK. Experience with Azure / AWS and their ML and AI services. Experience with knowledge graphs, rules engines, or other structured knowledge representations. Experience with predictive ML or optimization for problems such as forecasting, scheduling, ranking, or matching. Experience with guardrails, safety classifiers, or red-teaming for LLM applications. Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, including handling PHI under HIPAA.

title: Associate Lead
description:
Job Purpose 
As an AI Engineer in Data Intelligence Unit, you will help build and operate the core building blocks of Data Representation learning and Context Engineering across the credit Risk, Fraud/FRM, Sales, Collections Recovery. You will work with senior engineers and Data scientists to converts raw structured and unstructured data into reliable features, embeddings, retrieval-ready knowledge assets, and repeatable evaluation pipelines so downstream AI pods can ship models faster, safer, and with measurable quality. 
 Duties and Responsibilities 
1) Data Representation Pipelines
 
 Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,
 
CRM/operations)
 
 
 Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature
 
definitions.
 
 
 Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and
 
scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.
 
 
 Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and
 
lineage.
 
 
2) Knowledge Engineering Support (Canonical Objects Metadata Assets)
 
 Help create/maintain canonical objects, entity dictionaries, taxonomies/ontologies, and labeling guidelines.
 
 Support annotation/labeling workflows (quality checks, consistency, sampling) for training and evaluation.
 
 
3) Experimentation Model Operations
 
 Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.
 
 Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)
 
 Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.
 
 
4) Retrieval Context Engineering Support (LLM/RAG enablement)
 
 Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.
 
 Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by
 
Pods.
 
 Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.
 
5) Engineering Hygiene Governance
 
 Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.
 
 Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.
 
 Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability. 
 Required Qualifications and Experience 
Basic Qualifications:
 
 Bachelors/Masters in CS/Math/Engineering
 
 0 2 yearsexperience in Data Science /Applied ML/ ML Engineering with proven leadership delivering
 
production grade ML system at scale.
 
 
 
Required Skills Competencies Core (must-have) Programming: Python (strong), SQL (strong); Git; basic unit testing. Data: Pandas/PySpark basics, joins/aggregations/window functions, data validation and profiling. ML Fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, embeddings, train/val/test discipline, metrics, and error analysis. Applied System Mindset: reproducibility, structured debugging, logging/monitoring fundamentals. Good-to-have Skills ML frameworks: Pytorch / TensorFlow; experiment tracking (MLFlow) Retrieval stack: vector indexing concepts, chunking strategies, hybrid search ideas, evaluation datasets. Data/Infra: Airflow/Prefect, Spark, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MongoDB, feature stores, graph Database, vector database, model serving basics. Preferred Qualifications Experience building end-to-end decisioning platforms with real-time and batch orchestration. Graph ML / entity-resolution experience for relationship-based risk and fraud analysis. Experience operating ML systems across multiple products/segments with multi-tenant controls. Publications/patents or strong track record of innovation in applied ML, large-scale ML systems

Key Skills: Airflow,Ml,Program,Credit,Debugging,MongoDB,Programming,Sales

 Role: Engineering Lead 
 
 About Repos 
 Repos is redefining energy distribution through technology, innovation, and intelligent solutions. By combining technology, data, and operational excellence, we are building solutions that address complex real-world challenges across the energy ecosystem. 
 We are looking for an Engineering Lead who can translate business vision into robust technology solutions, lead high-performing engineering teams, and drive innovation across backend systems and AI-powered applications. 
 
 Role Overview 
 The Engineering Lead will own the technical direction, architecture, development, and delivery of scalable software solutions. This role requires strong expertise in Python, Django, and AI/ML , along with proven experience in software architecture, backend engineering, team leadership, and end-to-end product development. 
 The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, driving engineering excellence while ensuring that technology solutions are reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

 1. Engineering Leadership and Technical Strategy

 Drive technical decision-making, balancing innovation, maintainability, performance, and delivery timelines.

About Onit Were redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions. 
 We re a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. If youre energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we d love to meet you. 
 Position Summary This is a hands-on Senior Modern workplace engineer role focused on modern endpoint engineering, device identity, security, automation and lifecycle management. The role will own and evolve Microsofts modern workplace stack with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot at its core, integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint security, application deployment and patching. The successful candidate should be strong enough to solve complex L3 issues independently, but broad enough to understand how endpoint, identity, security and user experience work together. Onits technology environment changes quickly. The successful candidate will be evaluated not only on what they already know, but on how effectively they learn, apply and operationalize new capabilities. What This Role Is Expected to Deliver Build a secure, scalable and low-touch endpoint platform for Windows devices, with increasing capability across macOS. Reduce manual administration through PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and proactive remediation/automation. Improve device compliance, deployment quality, patch posture and endpoint security without creating unnecessary friction for users. Own endpoint-related projects from design and pilot through production rollout, documentation, change communication and operational handover. EPM, SAAS Management, Shadow IT/AI and AI Governance are key projects in Pipeline. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy and administer Microsoft Intune for device compliance, configuration profiles, security baselines, enrollment, application deployment and update management. Own Windows Autopilot end to end, including device registration, hardware hashes, deployment profiles, Enrollment Status Page (ESP), user-driven and pre-provisioned scenarios, troubleshooting and lifecycle operations. Design and maintain Conditional Access controls tied to compliant/corporate devices, MFA and Zero Trust access principles in partnership with security and identity stakeholders. Manage the endpoint-related Microsoft Entra ID surface, including device identity, registration, join states, authentication dependencies and access troubleshooting. Package, test and deploy Win32, Microsoft Store and line-of-business applications, including detection rules, dependencies, install/uninstall logic and remediation of failed deployments. Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for reporting, compliance, device operations, configuration validation and repetitive administration. Create and maintain proactive remediation / detection-remediation logic to address configuration drift, device health and recurring endpoint issues before they become tickets. Own Windows patch/update strategy using Windows Update for Business, update rings and related Microsoft capabilities; support application patching and verification processes. Implement and improve endpoint security controls including BitLocker, LAPS, attack-surface reduction/security baselines and integration with enterprise security tooling such as CrowdStrike or Microsoft Defender concepts. Support and progressively deepen macOS management capability using Jamf Pro/Apple Business Manager, ADE, FileVault and macOS compliance where applicable. Act as the L3 escalation point for complex enrollment failures, policy conflicts, Autopilot provisioning issues, application deployment failures and device compliance problems. Work across Microsoft 365 services such as OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams and Exchange Online where endpoint or identity policies intersect with the user experience. Evaluate new Microsoft/Apple endpoint capabilities, and recommend production adoption when they improve security, supportability or user experience. Create technical documentation, SOPs and runbooks; mentor other IT team members and transfer knowledge rather than becoming a single point of dependency. Required Skills - Must Have Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune administration in an enterprise environment. Strong Windows Autopilot implementation and troubleshooting experience. Strong understanding of compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines and device lifecycle management. Hands-on application packaging/deployment using Win32 (.intunewin) or equivalent enterprise packaging methods, including detection and dependency logic. Hands-on Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access experience, especially device-based access and compliance scenarios. Strong L3 troubleshooting ability across enrollment, policy, application deployment, authentication and compliance issues. Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation and troubleshooting. Practical endpoint security knowledge including disk encryption, endpoint hardening, patching and least-privilege concepts. Ability to independently plan and execute technical changes/projects with pilots, rollback thinking, stakeholder communication and post-change validation. PIM, SSO concepts (SAML/OIDC), enterprise application registration and broader Entra identity administration. Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager/ADE, FileVault and macOS administration. Adjacent Skills - Good to Have / Learn Quickly Microsoft Graph API automation and reporting. BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), Microsoft EPM or similar least-privilege tooling. CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or comparable endpoint security platforms. Microsoft 365 migration or tenant-to-tenant migration experience. ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR or similar control/compliance environments. What Success Looks Like Takes independent ownership of the Intune/Autopilot/Entra endpoint stack and becomes the escalation point for complex endpoint problems. Automates recurring endpoint work and reduces avoidable manual administration/tickets. Improves compliance, patching and endpoint security posture while keeping user experience practical. Builds working knowledge in adjacent areas such as Jamf/macOS, EPM and broader identity rather than remaining an Intune-only specialist. Demonstrates learnability: can identify a knowledge gap, self-learn, test in a lab/pilot, apply the capability in production, document it and transfer the knowledge to others. Experience & Qualifications 8+ years relevant experience across enterprise IT, Microsoft 365, endpoint/security or related infrastructure disciplines. Demonstrated experience owning production systems and resolving complex technical problems, not only following predefined operational procedures. Experience working with distributed/global stakeholders and managing technical changes across business teams is preferred. Bachelors degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline. Preferred Certifications Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) Microsoft 365 Administrator / MS-102 or equivalent Microsoft 365 administration certification Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) - preferred Jamf certification - advantage, not mandatory Benefits & Perks That Support You: Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond: Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members. Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually. Family Support: Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement. Income Protection: 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance. Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident . Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Flexi, NPS . Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

 We are seeking a hands-on, commercially minded Head of Digital Performance to lead paid media, SEO, AI search and a team of digital specialists. This is a full-time remote leadership position with meaningful overlap with the Australian business day. 
 This is not a role for someone who only manages task lists, accepts platform reports at face value or delegates technical judgement entirely to specialists. 
 What you will own 
 Commercial digital performance across multiple B2B accounts: lead quality, qualified opportunities, pipeline contribution and acquisition efficiency. Google Ads strategy and technical oversight, including Search, Performance Max, tracking, auction dynamics, search intent and budget allocation. SEO and local search strategy, with the technical confidence to audit work, identify ranking barriers and direct specialists. An AI-first delivery model: structured briefs, reusable AI skills/agents, automation and specialist QA that increase capacity without compromising accuracy. Measurement and CRM attribution across GA4, GTM, call tracking and lead-to-revenue reporting. Team performance, coaching, accountability, delivery quality and proactive client recommendations. 
 What makes this role different 
 You will be expected to use AI as an operating advantagenot simply to draft content. We want someone who has personally implemented repeatable AI-assisted workflows, knows where AI fails, builds human review into the process and can demonstrate measurable improvements in speed, quality or cost. 
 You must also be comfortable challenging specialists. If SEO rankings stall, tracking numbers conflict or cheap leads fail to become opportunities, you should know what to investigate, what to ask and what to do next. 
 You should bring 8+ years of digital/performance marketing experience, preferably in a multi-client agency and with substantial B2B lead-generation exposure. Proven direct leadership of specialists, including a real example of improving or managing sustained underperformance. Strong technical Google Ads expertise and credible hands-on SEO knowledgenot only reporting familiarity. Commercial fluency from traffic and leads through MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, pipeline and revenue. Strong GA4, GTM, Search Console, conversion optimisation and attribution judgement. Excellent English, concise senior-stakeholder communication and dependable Australian-time-zone crossover. 
 What success looks like 
 Client accounts are reviewed proactively and commercial risks are identified early. Specialists are clear on standards, ownership, deadlines and corrective actions. Reporting shows business outcomesnot just clicks, CPL and rankings. AI-assisted workflows reduce repetitive manual work while retaining specialist quality control. Digital delivery becomes more consistent, scalable and commercially effective. 
 Selection process 
 Shortlisted candidates will complete a structured interview, discuss a real AI-enabled workflow they have personally implemented, and undertake a time-boxed, anonymised B2B account review. We assess commercial judgement, technical depth, leadership and practical AI capabilitynot CV keywords alone. 
 Apply confidentially

title: Manager - Client Experience Support
description:
Purpose As a Client Experience Support Manager, you will manage Client support staff members and the work they perform to support our clients. You will drive process and performance improvement to meet or exceed customer expectations. You will focus on the team to provide enthusiastic support, which includes analyzing root-cause issues and solutions rather than addressing transactional support issues and hold staff accountable to consistent process and improved performance. Clinisys' AI Philosophy Building an AIfirst organisation is central to Clinisys purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AIenabled, cloudbased platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 42 countries, Clinisys expects all colleaguesregardless of role or functionto work confidently with AIenabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We must drive an AI-first sense of purpose and urgency. Essential Functions Manages performance of Client Support staff through mentoring, education, standard processes, client focus and metrics. Manage consistent metrics for the Client Support organization Daily, weekly and monthly reporting on organizational performance and productivity Measuring individual performance Monitor backlog and customer concerns trends to find root causes and provide solutions to processes and education/communication to all staff to implement changes. Drive continuous service improvement based on quality metrics and customer feedback. This would include management of customer concerns and service request management, including trend analysis and reporting. Responsible for planning and allocating resources to ensure team availability to resolve customer issues in a timely fashion. Responsible for developing strong business partnerships with other internal departments. Expected to recommend changes to products or services to fulfill customer needs and work with peers to refine and implement those changes. Responsible for supporting the organization by providing reference-able clients, providing client information and responding to inquiries from other areas of the organization. Accountable for talent development of direct staff to ensure adequate bench strength and succession planning including all employee related activities (i.e. hires, training, appraisals, rewards and recognition, and disciplinary action) including ongoing guidance, direction and mentoring Ability to be on-call on a rotational basis in a 24/7 environment All other duties and responsibilities as assigned Skills Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and mentor. Positive problem-solving mentality, seeking solutions and process improvements to enhance performance Ability to perform detailed analysis, out of the box thinking to identify solutions. Demonstrate high level of organizational and communication skills required for all aspects of daily duties Proven ability to use AI and emerging technologies responsibly to enable more efficient, consistent, and scalable ways of working. Required Experience & Education BA/BS Degree in Technology, Medical field or related degree 5-7 years’ experience in a product support environment Demonstrated experience with building business partnerships, improving client experience and happiness, process development and productivity improvement. 1-3 years’ supervisory/leadership experience Preferred Experience & Education Familiarity with software development, lifecycles and technical support processes preferred. Exposure to the Healthcare or IT industry preferred. Formal Presentation skills preferred. Supervisory Responsibilities 8-12 direct reports Physical Requirements Work is performed in a typical office setting with minimal exposure to health or safety hazards—prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Less than 10% travel may be required to client sites that can pose risks associated with healthcare organizations. Moderate lifting/carrying 15-44 lbs.; use of fingers; walking/standing 2-6 hours May be required to follow customer location health and safety requirements.
